messages.subject: Sustainability & Environmental Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Stakeholder Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Elliott,

EnviroTech Talent's specialist focus on environmental, sustainability and transition leadership makes this a relevant introduction.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans ESG and social performance, government and regulatory relations, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications within a major natural-resources operation.

I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership roles where sustainability strategy, regulatory credibility, stakeholder confidence and responsible growth must be managed together. Saudi Arabia is my first-priority market, followed by the UAE and wider GCC, while I remain internationally mobile for broader global appointments.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration for relevant current or future searches across ESG, sustainability, external affairs and stakeholder leadership.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
